say: A guard in a rain cape stands square in front of the gate. The cape has been mended more than once.

choices.text: The crew was pulled out before the collapse was reported.

say: Roof collapse, lower level. It's on the notice.
The guard looks at the gate, not at you.
I stand where I'm posted. That night I was posted here.
Yard lost power. Gate, floods, the lot. Dark till morning.
When it came back the door was how it is now. Nobody came down this road in between. I'd have seen.
And you didn't get any of that from this post.
There's the old spur line, round the east side. Washed out years back. Nobody uses it.
I can't see the spur from here. That's all I'm saying about the spur.
I can't see the spur from here.
Then I've been guarding a lid.
